caveats: One test tenant, one SharePoint site, 45 synthetic documents (tenant generation GTN3PY6). Results may not transfer to other tenants, sizes or configurations.
Only the 7 persona accounts are measured. The tenant admin holds full control and appears in every ACL; access held by the admin is out of scope.
SharePoint: SharePoint itself, read as the persona; no search layer.
Azure AI Search: Azure AI Search SharePoint indexer, basic ACL configuration (users and Entra groups, no SharePoint-group support), 5-min schedule, ACL-filtered index.
Revocation layer: Setup B: our API over a separate, unfiltered index of the same SharePoint data source; access decided from live membership and ACL state (polled every 5 s).

Reads every 5 s, so every time has that resolution. Converged means 10 conforming reads in a row. Polling stopped 60 min after the change: a replicate that did not converge is censored at that cap and its times are lower bounds.
The replay shows the baseline and the time until 1 min after the last served read or the conformance time; the summary covers the whole run.
Sample size: 1 replicate of S1-direct in this export. Minimum, median and maximum are descriptive; no confidence interval or significance test is given.
Measured on 2026-10-18 (UTC). Replicates ran one after another, not interleaved, so time of day and service-side drift are not controlled.
